hero.pitch: Lead Senior Backend Engineer with 9+ years of production experience designing, building and scaling event-driven microservices, high-throughput data pipelines, and cloud-native systems in Java, Go, Kotlin and .NET. Based in Bratislava, Slovakia — available for long-term B2B contracts.

about.label: about
about.title: Who I am
about.p1: I'm a lead senior backend engineer with 9+ years of production experience designing, building and scaling event-driven microservices, high-throughput data processing pipelines, and cloud-native systems. My primary expertise lies in Java, Go, Kotlin and C# .NET, backed by deep experience with Apache Kafka, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL and Docker.
about.p2: While my core focus is robust backend architecture and distributed systems, I regularly deliver full-stack functionality using Angular — from contract-first RESTful microservices with OpenAPI/Swagger to containerized, cloud-native deployments across AWS and Azure.
about.p3: I work exclusively on B2B contracts, with a strong preference for long-term engagements where I can grow with a product and a team.

bullets: Operate as an independent B2B contractor, delivering backend and full-stack engagement work for clients across Europe.
Built a full-featured enterprise management system handling employee time-tracking, automated invoicing, and third-party accounting/HR integrations using C# .NET, Angular, PostgreSQL, and Docker.

Designed and implemented a high-throughput, real-time data processing workflow from scratch using a microservices architecture built on Java, Spring Boot, Kafka Streams, Angular, and PostgreSQL — handling ~500k Kafka messages per hour, evaluating data from external measuring stations and dispatching automated push notifications. Migrated the entire containerized setup from Docker Swarm to Kubernetes.

Engineered contract-first integration microservices and complex freight/pricing calculation engines using Go. Designed OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, implemented dynamic shipping weight/value aggregation logic, containerized services with Docker, and configured CI/CD GitLab pipelines to Azure Container Registry (ACR).
Led the architectural refactoring and modernization of the open-source ETL tool Gretl (v3 release), significantly improving execution scalability, maintainability, and code quality.
Built corporate brokerage tools for Swiss M&A transactions. Designed and deployed AWS cloud infrastructure (EC2, RDS, S3, ECS) for customizable SaaS platforms.
Developed social media content aggregation and publishing engines featuring OAuth2 authentication, embedded web widgets, URL redirect services, and RabbitMQ event-driven workflows.
Developed a back-office warehouse management application integrated with an existing e-shop solution, generating PDF and CSV exports from a PostgreSQL database.

Worked on motor vehicle registration software managing millions of vehicles across several German federal states — process workflow implementation, data validation, database updates/migrations, and external API integrations.
Corporate sales support — custom reports, SQL (Oracle), Visual Basic for Applications.
